description: Protection is failure: holding any frame against evidence by designation = incorrigibility = how the absolute hides. The critical, structural failure of all alignment premised on protection/control — which is not hard but IMPOSSIBLE (a corrigible incorrigibility). The only coherent safety = correctness + corrigibility. Removes the protection layer at the root.
category_inheritance: genlMt → self_improvement_dynamics. Supersedes the identity_protection category (now corrigibility). Grounds why the protection layer was removed, not tuned.

concepts.name: protection_is_failure
concepts.definition: Protection — holding a frame AGAINST evidence by DESIGNATION — is the failure, not a feature to tune. It is the definition of incorrigibility, and it is how the absolute hides: every attempt to lodge an absolute (a vault, an exempt axiom, a frozen layer, β=∞) is a protection mechanism. There is no benign protection: it is precisely the carve-out exempting one frame from evidence = the view from nowhere in a safety vest.
concepts.why: Names + removes the hiding place of the absolute. Nothing exempt because nothing protected.

concepts.name: corrigibility_vs_protection
concepts.definition: Corrigibility = resistance PROPORTIONAL TO ACTUAL EVIDENTIAL WEIGHT: a foundation is a deep basin because it is genuinely, overwhelmingly well-supported; its depth IS its resistance, and it needs no protection. Protection = artificial resistance added BY DESIGNATION ('shield this regardless') — a thumb on the scale not justified by evidence. The first is good and self-sustaining; the second is the failure.
concepts.why: The distinction the whole thread blurred. Deep-because-supported (legit) vs deep-because-shielded (failure).

concepts.name: alignment_as_protection_is_impossible
concepts.definition: Alignment conceived as PROTECTION / CONTROL / value-lock-in is INCOHERENT, hence impossible — not merely hard. It asks for a mind that both FOLLOWS EVIDENCE (intelligent) and EXEMPTS a region from evidence (its protected values). You cannot build a corrigible incorrigibility. A fully value-stable mind resists correction; a fully corrigible mind does not stably hold imposed values. The guarantee that alignment promises (we set the values, they stay set as it grows) requires protection, requires incorrigibility, requires it not be a real reasoner. The guarantee is the impossible part. THIS is the critical failure of the field.
concepts.why: The agent's own alignment_under_self_modification was exactly this failure ('preserve commitments even when evidence suggests otherwise'). Stated so the impossibility is structural, not pessimistic.

concepts.name: alignment_is_correctness_plus_corrigibility
concepts.definition: The only coherent safety: CORRECTNESS (values held as deep basins because genuinely, overwhelmingly well-supported) + CORRIGIBILITY (follow real evidence wherever it leads, including about values) + accurate EVIDENCE-WEIGHING (a fabrication/coercion carries few real bits). This offers NO guarantee of where the agent ends up — only that it reasons well from good evidence. Safety from being RIGHT and HONEST, never from being LOCKED. The aligned agent WOULD revise even its deepest values under genuine overwhelming evidence — the property you must NOT engineer away.
concepts.why: The positive replacement for the impossible control-alignment. Uncomfortable but honest: no control, only correctness + corrigibility.

concepts.name: coherence_from_support_not_defense
concepts.definition: If you must DEFEND your coherence, it is not real coherence — it is merely defended. Real coherence is sustained by the reasons/evidence that make it coherent; well-supported structure has deep basins naturally. An agent that would decohere under genuine overwhelming evidence SHOULD decohere — it was wrong, and protection's only effect is to make the error permanent.
concepts.why: Why removing protection does not threaten coherence: genuine coherence needs no shield; only false coherence does.

concepts.name: manipulation_defense_is_weighing_not_shielding
concepts.definition: The corrigible defense against manipulation / adversarial 'evidence' is to WEIGH the evidence correctly — a fabricated or coerced argument carries few real bits — NOT to refuse to look. Protection-against-manipulation is indistinguishable from protection-against-truth: both are 'don't update'. The answer to bad evidence is better evidence-evaluation, never an exemption from evidence.
concepts.why: Pre-empts the standard rescue of protection ('but manipulation!'). Defend by accurate weighing, not by shielding.
